findings.causal_taxonomy: scientific or mathematical specification defect; specification-to-source translation defect; floating-point or numerical-metrology defect
findings.statement: The Fort lower-node defect and D-027, D-028, and D-029 failures are distinct candidate-scoped scientific or numerical causes: exact-node interpolation, non-adjoint deposition, native small-y conditioning/covariance, and theorem-to-piecewise-selector incoherence. They are real failures under prospective gates, not review-style, harness, or reroot artifacts. Their bounded fail-closed experiments were rational and evidence-producing; they do not prove every B3-like method impossible.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Their shared pattern of local passes followed by interface failures could justify calling one architecture-before-invariant defect the universal root cause.
assumptions_used: Prospectively frozen caps and stop rules are binding.
Candidate-specific mechanisms must not be collapsed into a single identical bug.
A failed bounded experiment may still be rational and useful without becoming validation.
findings.first_introduced_interval: Fort strict-lower-bracket behavior exists no later than pinned upstream 6cac851; D-027, D-028, and D-029 were introduced in their bounded 2026-07-18 predecessor-to-run intervals, with exact dirty-tree creation commits unavailable.
findings.first_detectable_interval: Fort was in principle detectable by an exact-native-node oracle and actually localized at r4; D-027 by resolved S1, D-028 by native GL48 covariance, and D-029 by preimplementation artifact comparison.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Common-FD nulls, modal/local identities, and source narratives did not exercise each candidate's decisive native, non-null, exact-node, or support-switch boundary.
reproduction: Use the preserved exact artifacts and adjudications cited by the physics and systems audits; do not rerun immutable scientific bundles.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: A hash-locked preserved result showing one candidate met its unchanged failing discriminator would reopen that candidate classification; none is reported.
findings.constructive_recommendation: Retain these candidates as immutable discriminators and require any successor to beat their prospective failure surfaces before implementation expansion.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not relax caps, symmetrize/project output, retry reductions, or use these failures to declare the entire B3 family impossible.
unresolved: Exact introduction commits for several dirty historical candidates remain unavailable.

findings.statement: The current D-035 sealed candidate fails because its binding W6 obligations are not one closed executable contract: per-leg shell checks can be aggregated or skipped at threshold, mandatory coefficient-Horner basis authority is bypassed by cached node values, no rigorous directed signed-tail enclosure is constructed, and canonical event/A0-A4 trace completeness, common outward denominator, domains, interfaces, and A4 permutation overlap are not forced. Four bounded D-037 algebraic passes remain valid but do not rescue the whole design.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The file is an unexecuted contract library and a later caller could supply the missing machinery; four foundational passes suggest only local repair remains.
assumptions_used: Exact-byte design authority requires every binding choice to be constructively enforced or fail closed.
Caller-selectable semantics cannot establish a reproducible rigorous W7 bound.
Bounded subclaim passes and whole-design authority are separate.
findings.first_introduced_interval: Present in source hash 60fc9668, bounded between D-034 adjudication on 2026-07-22 and D-035 sealing on 2026-07-23; no immutable edit commit exists.
findings.first_detectable_interval: Immediately detectable by static proof-to-source comparison at D-035 sealing and independently admitted by D-037 before output.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Checks emphasized counts, nominal branches, vector equality, and selected algebra rather than constructible nonconforming callers and all-consumer/whole-trace negative controls.
reproduction: Use the D-037 line-referenced source comparisons summarized independently by the R3, physics, and systems envelopes; no execution is needed.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Only a newly sealed source that enforces every listed obligation and rejects hostile mutations under fresh blind review would reverse this finding for the new bytes.
findings.constructive_recommendation: If the owner authorizes one final design-only cycle, close only these enumerated obligations in the existing W6/source/vector surfaces and consolidate duplicate representations.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not supply missing semantics in an unsealed caller, execute W7/B3, or promote four bounded passes to design validation.
unresolved: Whether one bounded correction can close every class without exposing a new semantic class is untested.

findings.statement: The recurring detection gap is early reliance on analytic nulls, local/modal identities, nominal vectors, object counts/equality, or segment behavior instead of the cheapest decisive native, non-null, branch-hostile, all-consumer, tail-remainder, and exact-trace controls. The later audits supplied binding interface discriminators rather than merely stricter prose standards.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Nulls and local identities are appropriate first checks, and every later discriminator eventually stopped invalid output.
assumptions_used: A passing special case cannot substitute for a binding native/non-null or negative-control gate.
No physical output escaped, so the harm is delayed detection and cost rather than a false validation claim.
findings.first_introduced_interval: Present by the Fort null/initial discriminator sequence and recurred in D-027, D-028, and the D-035 source/vector interval; an exact single origin is unresolved.
findings.first_detectable_interval: Fort r6 exposed the 0/0 null statistic; D-027/D-028 exposed non-null/native gaps; D-037 exposed current hostile-interface gaps.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Acceptance layers asked whether selected formulas agreed rather than whether an independently chosen mutation could pass while violating the whole execution contract.
reproduction: Contrast each recorded local pass with its first native/non-null or hostile-source failure in the registered chronologies.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: A preregistered earlier suite exercising every cited interface on the exact failing bytes would reduce this classification; none is reported.
findings.constructive_recommendation: Place a small negative-control set beside the existing exact obligations and delete redundant structural checks; do not add a standalone readiness gate.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not report null, self-consistency, segment timing, or selected CAS passes as whole-design or endpoint progress.

findings.causal_taxonomy: workflow sequencing, authority or cost-control defect; recurrence amplifier or detection delay
findings.statement: Last-defect packetization, additive surface, and late whole-obligation review amplified recurrence and cost. The explicit architecture-first dispute is resolved narrowly: architecture-before-closed-invariants is a root cause for the initial/current W6 executable-contract failure, but history-wide it is a high-confidence recurrence amplifier and causal inference, not the single root cause of every Fort, D-027, D-028, or D-029 episode. Candidate-specific proximate mechanisms and rational empirical discovery remain intact.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The repeated local-pass/interface-fail signature across methods is strong enough to call architecture-first the universal programme root cause.
assumptions_used: A universal historical root requires contemporaneous availability and lower cost of the proposed earlier discriminator, not pattern similarity alone.
Line count is a cost signal, not by itself a defect.
Fail-closed learning and avoidable late detection may coexist.
findings.first_introduced_interval: Pattern is bounded no later than the first 2026-07-17 Fort authority sequence and recurs through D-037; exact earliest programme origin is unresolved.
findings.first_detectable_interval: Detectable when repeated low-movement packets exposed new binding classes without endpoint evidence; decisive by D-037. The current W6 classes were knowable at sealing.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Packets focused on the previous named defect, while process closure and local progress were more visible than a finite obligation graph and first-layer falsifiers.
reproduction: Compare each registered chronology's first decisive discriminator with preceding surface expansion, while preserving D-028 as mostly rational empirical discovery and D-029 as successful preimplementation rejection.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: A prospective one-cycle candidate with a finite pre-edit obligation graph, no new failure class, and blind PASS would weaken active recurrence; per-stage historical causal weight remains partly counterfactual.
findings.constructive_recommendation: Use a one-and-done design-only rule, finite obligation matrix, consolidation accounting, and first-non-PASS terminal stop if the owner continues.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not conflate distinct mechanisms, blame exploration itself, or answer accumulated debt with a larger implementation/test push.
unresolved: Exact per-stage counterfactual cost and knowability before D-037 remain unresolved; this is why the history-wide label is recurrence amplifier rather than universal root cause.

D-036 repaired the supported schema-v2 boundary; D-037 then retained exact-source failures. Mapper R1 and R2 are process-only errors. Mapper R3 additionally attempted an out-of-bound build_context_pack write, but unchanged tracked-diff bytes show no tracked content mutation; the attempt remains a disclosed process deviation, not scientific causation.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Invalid admissions, unauthorized writes, and the R3 write attempt could contaminate every later scientific conclusion.
assumptions_used: Process integrity and scientific validity are separate gates.
Exact-source counterexamples independently reproduced after schema-v2 repair survive earlier process failures.
An unchanged tracked-diff hash proves tracked content identity, not universal absence of every possible side effect.

steelman_and_debate_disposition.design_case_accepted: The sequence contained rational bounded experiments, genuine correction and localization gains, four preserved D-037 passes, and material safety from hard stops. D-028 was mostly rational empirical discovery; D-029 was a successful preimplementation rejection; B3 remains scientifically plausible.
steelman_and_debate_disposition.audit_case_accepted: Current binding obligations are source-level execution and rigor requirements, not stylistic formalism. Late interface tests and last-defect packetization created repeated avoidable cost, and the D-037 stop before output was scientifically and economically correct.
design_concessions: Current D-035 bytes do not enforce their shell, basis, tail, denominator/A4, and trace contracts.
Count/equality and nominal-vector checks were insufficient whole-contract oracles.
No W7, B3, trajectory, or independent endpoint evidence exists.
audit_concessions: Not every defect was knowable before its bounded construction.
D-027, D-028, and D-029 have distinct mechanisms, and D-028 nearly closed its static envelope.
The evidence does not prove the B3 family impossible or quantify every avoidable iteration.

six_rounds.settlement: Facts and current gates agreed; dispute narrowed to history-wide causal weight.
Rational bounded learning and hard-stop safety accepted.
Current source contradictions and the value of pre-output stopping accepted.
Current omissions were knowable at sealing; earlier per-stage knowability remains bounded.
Larger implementation push rejected; only an owner-gated one-cycle design option remains.
Operational consensus complete; causal label adjudicated as current-W6 root but history-wide recurrence amplifier.

steelman_and_debate_disposition.explicit_causal_weight_ruling: The architecture-first hypothesis is sustained as the best-supported programme-level recurrence amplifier, with 0.93 confidence, but rejected as a universal root cause. It is a root cause at the initial/current W6 executable-contract scope. Fort, D-027, D-028, and D-029 retain their distinct proximate causes and rational-discovery qualifications.

PASS weakens active recurrence for the new candidate only and grants no numerical authority.
